<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.forward" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</refname>
  <refpurpose>Forward the current request to another action</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>action</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>parameters</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>controller</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>action</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>parameters</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>module</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>controller</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>action</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>parameters</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Forward the current request to another action. The target is
   determined from the number and types of the arguments:
  </simpara>
  <simplelist>
   <member><parameter>action</parameter> only: forward to another action of the current controller.</member>
   <member><parameter>controller</parameter> and <parameter>action</parameter>: forward to another controller.</member>
   <member><parameter>module</parameter>, <parameter>controller</parameter> and <parameter>action</parameter>: forward to another module.</member>
   <member>The optional <parameter>parameters</parameter> array carries invocation arguments retrievable with <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname>.</member>
  </simplelist>
  <note>
   <simpara>
    This method does not switch to the destination action immediately;
    the switch takes place after the current flow finishes. To hand over
    control right away, return from the current action method (returning
    &false; also tells Yaf not to auto-render the current view).
   </simpara>
  </note>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>module</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The destination module name. If the current module is given, it is
      used as is.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>controller</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The destination controller name.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>action</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The destination action name.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>parameters</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Invocation arguments for the destination action, retrievable
      with <methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname>.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns &true; on success, or &false; / &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction() {
        $logined = $_SESSION["login"];
        if (!$logined) {
            $this->forward("login", array("from" => "Index")); // forward to the login action
            return false; // this is important, it ends the current flow
                          // and tells Yaf not to auto-render
        }

        // other processes
    }

    public function loginAction() {
        echo "login, redirected from ", $this->_request->getParam("from") , " action";
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
   login, redirected from Index action
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Request_Abstract::getParam</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.getinvokearg" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getInvokeArg</refname>
  <refpurpose>Retrieve one action invocation argument</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>string</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getInvokeArg</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Returns a single invocation argument of the current action, given its
   name. Invocation arguments are passed to the action through
   <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The name of the invocation argument to retrieve.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The argument value, or &null; if it does not exist.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getInvokeArg</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class UserController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction() {
        // forward to the profile action of this controller,
        // carrying invocation arguments
        $this->forward("profile", array("name" => "laruence"));
        return false; // ends the current flow
    }

    public function profileAction() {
        // retrieve one invocation argument by name
        var_dump($this->getInvokeArg("name"));
        var_dump($this->getInvokeArg("missing"));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(8) "laruence"
NULL
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getInvokeArgs</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

  <simpara>

   keyed by argument name. Invocation arguments are passed to the action
   through <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::forward</methodname>.

class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function apiAction() {
        // build the answer ourselves, no template needed
        Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->disableView();

        $response = $this->getResponse();
        $response->setHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
        $response->setBody(json_encode(array("name" => "yaf")));
        // Yaf sends the body after the dispatch loop finishes
    }
}
?>
]]>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.init" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::init</refname>
  <refpurpose>Controller initializer</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::init</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::__construct</methodname> is not
   meant to be overridden with custom logic, so
   <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::init</methodname> is provided as
   the userland initialization hook. If it is defined in a controller, it
   is called right after the controller object is instantiated.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   No value is returned.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::init</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    // init() is called right after the controller is instantiated,
    // before any action is dispatched
    public function init() {
        $this->getView()->assign("sitename", "Yaf Tutorial");
    }

    public function indexAction() {
        // ...
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::__construct</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.initview" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::initView</refname>
  <refpurpose>Initialize the view and return it</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_View_Interface</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::initView</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>options</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Returns the view engine bound to this controller. The view engine is
   initialized by the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> during
   dispatching, using the template path set for the current controller.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>options</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Options passed to the view engine, see
      <methodname>Yaf_View_Simple::__construct</methodname>.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   A <classname>Yaf_View_Interface</classname> instance on success, or
   &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::initView</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction() {
        // fetch the view engine bound to this controller, initialized
        // with its template path, e.g. application/views/;
        // options would be forwarded to the view engine, see
        // Yaf_View_Simple::__construct()
        $view = $this->initView();
        $view->assign("products", array("yaf", "php"));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::getView</methodname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_View_Interface</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.redirect" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::redirect</refname>
  <refpurpose>Redirect to a URL</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::redirect</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>url</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Redirects the client to another URL by sending a
   <literal>Location</literal> header (HTTP status 302).
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>url</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The URL to redirect to.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns &true; on success, or &false; / &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::redirect</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class AccountController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function loginAction() {
        if (!$this->getRequest()->getParam("user")) {
            // send a Location header with HTTP status 302
            $this->redirect("http://www.example.com/account/login/");
            return false; // skip auto-rendering
        }
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.render" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::render</refname>
  <refpurpose>Render view template</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>protected</modifier> <type class="union"><type>string</type><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::render</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>tpl</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>array</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>parameters</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Renders the view script <parameter>tpl</parameter> and returns the
   output, unlike
   <methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::display</methodname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>tpl</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The view script name, relative to the view path.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>parameters</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      An associative array of variables to export to the view
      script for this rendering.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The rendered output as a &string; on success, or &false; on
   failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::render</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction() {
        // do not auto-render the default template
        Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->disableView();

        // render product/index.phtml and return the output
        // instead of sending it directly (as display() would)
        $html = $this->render("product/index.phtml", array(
            "products" => array("yaf", "php"),
        ));

        // post-process and set it as the response body
        $this->getResponse()->setBody($html);
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::display</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-controller-abstract.setviewpath" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::setViewpath</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set the view path</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::setViewpath</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>view_directory</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Sets the template directory of the view engine bound to this
   controller.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>view_directory</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The directory that holds the view templates.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns &true; on success, or &false; / &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Controller_Abstract::setViewpath</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ProductController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function init() {
        // from now on templates of this controller are looked up
        // under application/themes/dark/views/
        $this->setViewpath(APPLICATION_PATH . "/themes/dark/views");
    }

    public function indexAction() {
        // renders application/themes/dark/views/product/index.phtml
        $this->display("product/index.phtml");
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>

   </simplelist>

 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.autorender" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</refname>
  <refpurpose>Switch on/off autorendering</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>bool</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> will render the view
   automatically after dispatching an incoming request. You can prevent
   the rendering by calling this method with
   <parameter>flag</parameter> &false;.
  </simpara>
  <note>
   <simpara>
    You can also simply return &false; in an action to prevent the
    auto-rendering of that action only.
   </simpara>
  </note>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Whether to enable auto-rendering.
     </simpara>
     <note>
      <simpara>
       Since Yaf 2.2.0, if this parameter is not given, the current state
       is returned instead.
      </simpara>
     </note>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself when
   <parameter>flag</parameter> is given, or a &boolean; indicating whether
   auto-rendering is enabled when it is not.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract {
     /* init method will be called as soon as a controller is initialized */
     public function init() {
         if ($this->getRequest()->isXmlHttpRequest()) {
             //do not call render for ajax request
             //we will output a json string
             Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->autoRender(FALSE);
         }
     }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::flushInstantly</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.catchexception" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::catchException</refname>
  <refpurpose>Switch on/off exception catching</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>bool</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::catchException</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   While
   <link linkend="configuration.yaf.dispatcher.throwexception">application.dispatcher.throwException</link>
   is on (which can also be enabled by calling
   <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</methodname>), Yaf throws
   exceptions when errors occur instead of triggering errors.
  </simpara>
  <simpara>
   If exception catching is additionally enabled via this method (or via
   <link linkend="configuration.yaf.dispatcher.catchexception">application.dispatcher.catchException</link>),
   all uncaught exceptions are caught and dispatched to
   <literal>ErrorController::error</literal>, if one is defined.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Whether Yaf should catch uncaught exceptions and dispatch them to
      <literal>ErrorController::error</literal>.
     </simpara>
     <note>
      <simpara>
       Since Yaf 2.2.0, if this parameter is not given, the current state
       is returned instead.
      </simpara>
     </note>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself when
   <parameter>flag</parameter> is given, or a &boolean; indicating whether
   exception catching is enabled when it is not.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Dispatcher::catchException</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/* if you defined an ErrorController like following */
class ErrorController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract {
     /**
      * you can also call Yaf_Request_Abstract::getException to get the
      * uncaught exception.
      */
     public function errorAction($exception) {
        /* an error occurred */
        switch ($exception->getCode()) {
            case YAF_ERR_NOTFOUND_MODULE:
            case YAF_ERR_NOTFOUND_CONTROLLER:
            case YAF_ERR_NOTFOUND_ACTION:
            case YAF_ERR_NOTFOUND_VIEW:
                echo 404, ":", $exception->getMessage();
                break;
            default :
                $message = $exception->getMessage();
                echo 0, ":", $exception->getMessage();
                break;
        }
     }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
/* now if some error occurs, assuming accessing a non-existent controller
   (or you can throw an exception yourself): */
404:Could not find controller script **/application/controllers/No-exists-controller.php
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setErrorHandler</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::__construct</refname>
  <refpurpose>Yaf_Dispatcher constructor</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>private</modifier> <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> implements the singleton pattern,
   so the constructor is private. Use
   <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance</methodname> to retrieve the
   dispatcher instance, which is created by
   <classname>Yaf_Application</classname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   &return.void;
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> is a singleton</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

// Yaf_Dispatcher implements the singleton pattern, so its constructor is
// private. Retrieve the instance with Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()
// instead of calling `new`.
$dispatcher = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance();

var_dump($dispatcher instanceof Yaf_Dispatcher);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Application::getDispatcher</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.disableview" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::disableView</refname>
  <refpurpose>Disable view rendering</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::disableView</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Turn off view rendering. This is typically used for actions that
   generate their own output, such as actions returning JSON data.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, or &null; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::disableView</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

// Turn off view rendering globally, every action is expected to produce
// its output itself (e.g. a JSON API service).
Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->disableView();

$app->run();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::enableView</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.dispatch" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::dispatch</refname>
  <refpurpose>Dispatch a request</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><type>null</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::dispatch</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   This method does the heavy work of the
   <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname>. It takes a request object.
  </simpara>
  <para>
   The dispatch process has three distinct events:
   <simplelist>
    <member>Routing</member>
    <member>Dispatching</member>
    <member>Response</member>
   </simplelist>
   Routing takes place exactly once, using the values in the request object
   when <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::dispatch</methodname> is called.
   Dispatching takes place in a loop; a request may either indicate
   multiple actions to dispatch, or the controller or a plugin may reset
   the request object to force additional actions to dispatch (see
   <classname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</classname>). When all is done, the
   <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> returns a response.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      A <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance to dispatch.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance on success,
   &false; on failure, or &null; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::dispatch</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");
$app->bootstrap();

// Build a request pointing at ProductController::detailAction and
// dispatch it manually.
$request = new Yaf_Request_Http("/product/detail/id/42");

$response = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->dispatch($request);

if ($response instanceof Yaf_Response_Abstract) {
    $response->response();
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Application::run</methodname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.enableview" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::enableView</refname>
  <refpurpose>Enable view rendering</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::enableView</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Turn on view rendering. This is the opposite of
   <methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::disableView</methodname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, or &null; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::enableView</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class ApiPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function routerStartup(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        $dispatcher = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance();

        if ($request->getModuleName() === "Api") {
            // API actions emit JSON themselves, no view rendering wanted
            $dispatcher->disableView();
        } else {
            $dispatcher->enableView();
        }
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::disableView</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::autoRender</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.flushinstantly" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::flushInstantly</refname>
  <refpurpose>Switch on/off the instant flushing</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>bool</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::flushInstantly</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Switch on/off instant flushing. When enabled (the default), the
   response body is flushed to the client immediately once it is set by
   <methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setBody</methodname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Whether to flush the response body instantly.
     </simpara>
     <note>
      <simpara>
       Since Yaf 2.2.0, if this parameter is not given, the current state
       is returned instead.
      </simpara>
     </note>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself when
   <parameter>flag</parameter> is given, or a &boolean; indicating the current
   state when it is not.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::flushInstantly</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

$dispatcher = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance();

// Do not flush the response body to the client as soon as it is set
$dispatcher->flushInstantly(false);

// Since Yaf 2.2.0, calling it without arguments queries the current state
var_dump($dispatcher->flushInstantly());

$app->run();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(false)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::returnResponse</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Response_Abstract::setBody</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.getdefaultaction" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getDefaultAction</refname>
  <refpurpose>Retrieve the default action name</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>string</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getDefaultAction</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Get the default action name, which is used when an action name can not
   be extracted from the request URI. Defaults to
   <literal>"index"</literal>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The default action name, or &null; if the application is not
   initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getDefaultAction</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

$dispatcher = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance();

var_dump($dispatcher->getDefaultAction());

$dispatcher->setDefaultAction("main");
var_dump($dispatcher->getDefaultAction());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(5) "index"
string(4) "main"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultAction</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.getrequest" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRequest</refname>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRequest</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Retrieve the request object held by the dispatcher.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance, or &null; if
   the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRequest</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class IndexController extends Yaf_Controller_Abstract
{
    public function indexAction()
    {

        return false;

   by the dispatcher.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

  &no.function.parameters;

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.getrouter" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRouter</refname>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Router</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRouter</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Retrieve the <classname>Yaf_Router</classname> instance used by the
   dispatcher to route requests.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   The <classname>Yaf_Router</classname> instance, or &null; if the
   application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::getRouter</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initRoute(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $router = $dispatcher->getRouter();

        // Route /product/42 to ProductController::detailAction
        $router->addRoute("product", new Yaf_Route_Rewrite(

            array("controller" => "product", "action" => "detail")
        ));

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.registerplugin" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::registerPlugin</refname>
  <refpurpose>Register a plugin</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::registerPlugin</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</type><parameter>plugin</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Register a plugin (see <classname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</classname>).
   Generally, plugins are registered in Bootstrap (see
   <classname>Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract</classname>).
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>plugin</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      A <classname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</classname> instance.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, or &false; / &null; on failure.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Dispatcher::registerPlugin</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract {
  public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher) {
    /**
    * Yaf assumes plugin scripts under [application.directory] .  "/plugins" 
    * for this case, it will be:
    * [application.directory] . "/plugins/" . "User" . [application.ext]
    */ 
    $user = new UserPlugin();
    $dispatcher->registerPlugin($user);
  }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract</classname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.returnresponse" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::returnResponse</refname>
  <refpurpose>Switch on/off returning the response</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>bool</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::returnResponse</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>bool</type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>false</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Switch whether
   <methodname>Yaf_Application::run</methodname> returns the response
   object instead of sending it to the client directly. When enabled,
   <literal>$response = $app->run()</literal> gives you the
   <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance so it can be
   further manipulated. Available since Yaf 3.2.2.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Whether to return the response instead of sending it.
     </simpara>
     <note>
      <simpara>
       If this parameter is not given, the current state is returned
       instead.
      </simpara>
     </note>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself when
   <parameter>flag</parameter> is given, or a &boolean; indicating the current
   state when it is not.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::returnResponse</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->returnResponse(true);

// $app->run() now returns the response instead of flushing it
$response = $app->run();

$response->setHeader("X-Generator", "Yaf");
$response->response();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Application::run</methodname></member>
    <member><classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>action</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Change the action name which is used when an action name can not be
   extracted from the request URI. The name is normalized to lowercase.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>action</parameter></term>

     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, or &false; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.setdefaultmodule" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultModule</refname>
  <refpurpose>Change default module name</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultModule</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>module</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Change the module name which is used when a module name can not be
   extracted from the request URI. The module must be a registered one,
   see <methodname>Yaf_Application::getModules</methodname>.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>module</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The name of a registered module.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, &false; if the given module is not registered (and a
   <constant>YAF_ERR_TYPE_ERROR</constant> is triggered) or if the
   application is not initialized, or &null; otherwise.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="errors">
  &reftitle.errors;
  <simpara>
   Triggers a <constant>YAF_ERR_TYPE_ERROR</constant> error if
   <parameter>module</parameter> is not a registered module name.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setDefaultModule</methodname> example</title>

// "Home" must be a registered module, e.g. via

Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->setDefaultModule("Home");

$app->run();
?>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.seterrorhandler" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setErrorHandler</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set error handler</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setErrorHandler</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>mixed</type><parameter>callback</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>int</type><parameter>error_types</parameter><initializer>0</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Set an error handler for Yaf. When
   <link linkend="configuration.yaf.dispatcher.throwexception">application.dispatcher.throwException</link>
   is off, Yaf triggers catchable errors when unexpected errors occur.
  </simpara>
  <simpara>
   This method is a wrapper of <function>set_error_handler</function>;
   the handler is called whenever such an error is raised.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>callback</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      A callable callback, with the same semantics as the callback passed
      to <function>set_error_handler</function>.     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>error_types</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      The error types to handle, same as the
      <parameter>error_levels</parameter> parameter of
      <function>set_error_handler</function>. Defaults to handling all error types.
     </simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, &false; if calling <function>set_error_handler</function> failed,
   or &null; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setErrorHandler</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(dirname(__FILE__) . "/conf/application.ini");

Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->setErrorHandler(function ($errno, $errstr) {
    // Route errors to ErrorController::errorAction
    $request = Yaf_Dispatcher::getInstance()->getRequest();
    $request->setControllerName("Error");
    $request->setActionName("error");
});

$app->run();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Application::getLastErrorNo</methodname></member>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Application::getLastErrorMsg</methodname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.setview" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setView</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set a custom view engine</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>null</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::setView</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_View_Interface</type><parameter>view</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
     This method provides a solution if you want use a custom view
     engine instead of <classname>Yaf_View_Simple</classname>
  </para>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>view</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
       A <classname>Yaf_View_Interface</classname> instance
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself on
   success, or &null; if the application is not initialized.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title>A custom View engine example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
require "/path/to/smarty/Smarty.class.php";

class Smarty_Adapter implements Yaf_View_Interface
{
    /**
     * Smarty object
     * @var Smarty
     */
    public $_smarty;
 
    /**
     * Constructor
     *
     * @param string $tmplPath
     * @param array $extraParams
     * @return void
     */
    public function __construct($tmplPath = null, $extraParams = array()) {
        $this->_smarty = new Smarty;
 
        if (null !== $tmplPath) {
            $this->setScriptPath($tmplPath);
        }
 
        foreach ($extraParams as $key => $value) {
            $this->_smarty->$key = $value;
        }
    }
 
    /**
     * Set the path to the templates
     *
     * @param string $path The directory to set as the path.
     * @return void
     */
    public function setScriptPath($path)
    {
        if (is_readable($path)) {
            $this->_smarty->template_dir = $path;
            return;
        }
 
        throw new Exception('Invalid path provided');
    }
 
    /**
     * Assign a variable to the template
     *
     * @param string $key The variable name.
     * @param mixed $val The variable value.
     * @return void
     */
    public function __set($key, $val)
    {
        $this->_smarty->assign($key, $val);
    }
 
    /**
     * Allows testing with empty() and isset() to work
     *
     * @param string $key
     * @return boolean
     */
    public function __isset($key)
    {
        return (null !== $this->_smarty->get_template_vars($key));
    }
 
    /**
     * Allows unset() on object properties to work
     *
     * @param string $key
     * @return void
     */
    public function __unset($key)
    {
        $this->_smarty->clear_assign($key);
    }
 
    /**
     * Assign variables to the template
     *
     * Allows setting a specific key to the specified value, OR passing
     * an array of key => value pairs to set en masse.
     *
     * @see __set()
     * @param string|array $spec The assignment strategy to use (key or
     * array of key => value pairs)
     * @param mixed $value (Optional) If assigning a named variable,
     * use this as the value.
     * @return void
     */
    public function assign($spec, $value = null) {
        if (is_array($spec)) {
            $this->_smarty->assign($spec);
            return;
        }
 
        $this->_smarty->assign($spec, $value);
    }
 
    /**
     * Clear all assigned variables
     *
     * Clears all variables assigned to Yaf_View either via
     * {@link assign()} or property overloading
     * ({@link __get()}/{@link __set()}).
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public function clearVars() {
        $this->_smarty->clear_all_assign();
    }
 
    /**
     * Processes a template and returns the output.
     *
     * @param string $name The template to process.
     * @return string The output.
     */
    public function render($name, $value = NULL) {
        return $this->_smarty->fetch($name);
    }

    public function display($name, $value = NULL) {
        echo $this->_smarty->fetch($name);
    }

}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Dispatcher::setView</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract {

    /**
     * there are some config for smarty in the config:
     *
     * smarty.left_delimiter   = "{{"
     * smarty.right_delimiter  = "}}"
     * smarty.template_dir     = APPLICATION_PATH "/views/scripts/"
     * smarty.compile_dir      = APPLICATION_PATH "/views/templates_c/"
     * smarty.cache_dir        = APPLICATION_PATH "/views/templates_d/"
     *
     */
    public function _initConfig() {
        $config = Yaf_Application::app()->getConfig();
        Yaf_Registry::set("config", $config);
    }

    public function _initLocalName() {
        /** we put class Smarty_Adapter under the local library directory */
        Yaf_Loader::getInstance()->registerLocalNamespace('Smarty');
    }

    public function _initSmarty(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher) {
        $smarty = new Smarty_Adapter(null, Yaf_Registry::get("config")->get("smarty"));
        $dispatcher->setView($smarty);
        /* now the Smarty view engine become the default view engine of Yaf */
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-dispatcher.throwexception" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</refname>
  <refpurpose>Switch on/off exception throwing</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Dispatcher</type><type>bool</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type class="union"><type>bool</type><type>null</type></type><parameter>flag</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>
   Switch on/off exception throwing when an unexpected error occurs. When
   this is on, Yaf throws exceptions instead of triggering catchable
   errors.
  </simpara>
  <simpara>
   You can also use
   <link linkend="configuration.yaf.dispatcher.throwexception">application.dispatcher.throwException</link>
   to achieve the same purpose.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>flag</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <simpara>
      Whether Yaf should throw exceptions on errors.
     </simpara>
     <note>
      <simpara>
       Since Yaf 2.2.0, if this parameter is not given, the current state
       is returned instead.
      </simpara>
     </note>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>
   Returns the <classname>Yaf_Dispatcher</classname> object itself when
   <parameter>flag</parameter> is given, or a &boolean; indicating whether
   exception throwing is enabled when it is not.
  </simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = array(
    'application' => array(
        'directory' => dirname(__FILE__),
    ),
);
$app = new Yaf_Application($config);

$app->getDispatcher()->throwException(true);

try {
    $app->run();
} catch (Yaf_Exception $e) {
    var_dump($e->getMessage());
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
string(59) "Could not find controller script /tmp/controllers/Index.php"
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><function>Yaf_Dispatcher::throwException</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$config = array(
    'application' => array(
        'directory' => dirname(__FILE__),
    ),
);
$app = new Yaf_Application($config);

$app->getDispatcher()->throwException(false);

$app->run();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
PHP Catchable fatal error:  Yaf_Application::run(): Could not find controller script /tmp/controllers/Index.php in /tmp/1.php on line 12
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <para>
   <simplelist>
    <member><methodname>Yaf_Dispatcher::catchException</methodname></member>
    <member><exceptionname>Yaf_Exception</exceptionname></member>
   </simplelist>
  </para>
 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-exception.getprevious" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Exception::getPrevious</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve the previous exception</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>Throwable</type><methodname>Yaf_Exception::getPrevious</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This method is inherited from the base <exceptionname>Throwable</exceptionname> hierarchy and returns the exception that was chained as the previous one, if any.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <simpara>Returns the previous <exceptionname>Throwable</exceptionname> if available, &null; otherwise.</simpara>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Exception::getPrevious</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
try {
    $previous = new RuntimeException("Failed to open view script", 1024);
    throw new Yaf_Exception(
        "Failed to dispatch the request",
        YAF_ERR_DISPATCH_FAILED,
        $previous
    );
} catch (Yaf_Exception $e) {
    var_dump($e->getCode());
    $prev = $e->getPrevious();
    var_dump(get_class($prev));
    var_dump($prev->getMessage());
    var_dump($prev->getCode());
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
int(514)
string(16) "RuntimeException"
string(26) "Failed to open view script"
int(1024)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>


 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Exception::__construct</methodname></member>
   <member><exceptionname>Yaf_Exception</exceptionname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <simpara>Constructs a new loader. The constructor is private; <classname>Yaf_Loader</classname> is a singleton. Use <methodname>Yaf_Loader::getInstance</methodname> to obtain the instance.</simpara>

   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.getinstance" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::getInstance</refname>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public static</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Loader</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getInstance</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>local_library_path</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>global_library_path</parameter><initializer>null</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieve the singleton <classname>Yaf_Loader</classname> instance.</simpara>
  <simpara>If the library paths are given, they are applied to the existing instance.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>local_library_path</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The local library directory, usually the same as the <literal>application.library.directory</literal> ini setting.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>global_library_path</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The global library directory. If not given, the local one is used.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getInstance</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app = new Yaf_Application(__DIR__ . "/conf/application.ini");

/* Yaf_Application has initialized the loader, so the
 * singleton instance is available now */
$loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance();
$loader->registerNamespace("Vendor", APPLICATION_PATH . "/library/Vendor");
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getInstance</methodname> before initialization</title>

<![CDATA[
<?php
/* no Yaf_Application has been created yet */

?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(false)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.getnamespacepath" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::getNamespacePath</refname>
<refpurpose>Retrieve the library path of a class</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>string</type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getNamespacePath</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>class_name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Retrieve the library directory a class would be looked up in.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>class_name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The class name whose library directory is requested.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>The local library directory if the class belongs to a registered local namespace, otherwise the global library directory (falling back to the local one when the global one is not set).</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getNamespacePath</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$app    = new Yaf_Application(__DIR__ . "/conf/application.ini");
$loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance();

$loader->registerLocalNamespace("Models");
$loader->setLibraryPath("/usr/local/share/yaf/library", true);

/* "Models" is a registered local namespace */
echo $loader->getNamespacePath("Models_Product"), PHP_EOL;

/* other classes fall back to the global library directory */
echo $loader->getNamespacePath("Vendor_Payment"), PHP_EOL;
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
/var/www/shop/application/library
/usr/local/share/yaf/library
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::isLocalName</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getLibraryPath</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.import" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::import</refname>
<refpurpose>Load a PHP script</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public static</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::import</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>file</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Load a PHP script file once. If the file is not an absolute path, it is looked up under the local library directory.</simpara>
  <simpara>A file is only included once; calling <methodname>Yaf_Loader::import</methodname> again with the same file returns &true; without re-including it.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>file</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The file to load.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns &true; on success (including when the file was already loaded), or &false; on failure.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::import</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initHelpers()
    {
        /* a relative path is looked up under the library
         * directory, i.e. APPLICATION_PATH/library/functions/format.php */
        Yaf_Loader::import("functions/format.php");
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
  <example>
   <title>A file is imported only once</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
/* an absolute path is used as-is */
Yaf_Loader::import("/var/www/shop/application/library/Legacy/csv_export.php");

/* importing the same file again does nothing and returns true */
var_dump(
    Yaf_Loader::import("/var/www/shop/application/library/Legacy/csv_export.php")
);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
bool(true)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::autoload</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-loader.registerlocalnamespace" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Loader::registerLocalNamespace</refname>
<refpurpose>Register local namespace</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type class="union"><type>Yaf_Loader</type><type>false</type></type><methodname>Yaf_Loader::registerLocalNamespace</methodname>
   <methodparam><type class="union"><type>string</type><type>array</type></type><parameter>namespace</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>path</parameter><initializer>&null;</initializer></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>Register a local namespace. Classes whose prefix belongs to a local namespace are looked up under the given path (or the local library directory when no path is given) instead of the global one.</simpara>
  <simpara>This lets you place your own classes into the local library directory, while shared classes live in the global library directory (see the <literal>yaf.library</literal> ini setting).</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>namespace</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>A namespace prefix string, or an array of prefix/path pairs (when the value is a path string) or prefix strings.</simpara>
<simpara>A prefix only matches at an underscore or backslash boundary: registering <literal>Models</literal> makes <literal>Models_User</literal> and <literal>Models</literal> itself local, but not <literal>ModelsUser</literal>. A leading backslash is ignored, and a class name written with backslashes is looked up as if they were underscores.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>path</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The directory to look up the namespace in. If not given, the local library directory is used.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>Returns the loader instance itself on success, or &false; if an invalid parameter is provided.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Loader::registerLocalNamespace</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initLoader()
    {
        $loader = Yaf_Loader::getInstance();

        /* Models_User is now looked up in
         * APPLICATION_PATH/library/Models/User.php */
        $loader->registerLocalNamespace("Models");

        /* register several prefixes at once, each with its
         * own lookup directory */
        $loader->registerLocalNamespace(array(
            "Services" => APPLICATION_PATH . "/services",
            "Vendor"   => APPLICATION_PATH . "/vendor",
        ));
    }
}
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="seealso">
  &reftitle.seealso;
  <simplelist>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::getLocalNamespace</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::clearLocalNamespace</methodname></member>
   <member><methodname>Yaf_Loader::isLocalName</methodname></member>
  </simplelist>
 </refsect1>
</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.dispatchloopshutdown" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopShutdown</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook after dispatch loop</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopShutdown</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered once, after the dispatch loop has finished and all actions have been executed, but before the response is sent to the client. It is usually used for logging or cleanup.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopShutdown</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class AccessLogPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function dispatchLoopShutdown(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* last hook before the response is sent: write an
         * access log entry */
        error_log(sprintf(
            "[%s] %s dispatched to %s/%s",
            date("c"),
            $request->getRequestUri(),
            $request->getControllerName(),
            $request->getActionName()
        ));
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new AccessLogPlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>

<refentry xml:id="yaf-plugin-abstract.dispatchloopstartup" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
<refname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopStartup</refname>
<refpurpose>Hook before dispatch loop</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>void</type><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopStartup</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Request_Abstract</type><parameter>request</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>Yaf_Response_Abstract</type><parameter>response</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <simpara>This hook is triggered once, right before the dispatch loop starts and the view engine is initialized.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>request</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Request_Abstract</classname> instance being dispatched.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>response</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
<simpara>The <classname>Yaf_Response_Abstract</classname> instance.</simpara>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
<simpara>No value is returned.</simpara>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>Yaf_Plugin_Abstract::dispatchLoopStartup</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
class BenchmarkPlugin extends Yaf_Plugin_Abstract
{
    public function dispatchLoopStartup(Yaf_Request_Abstract $request, Yaf_Response_Abstract $response)
    {
        /* the view engine is not initialized yet, so this hook is a
         * good place to start request-wide bookkeeping */
        Yaf_Registry::set("request_start", microtime(true));
    }
}

/* plugins are registered in the bootstrap */
class Bootstrap extends Yaf_Bootstrap_Abstract
{
    public function _initPlugin(Yaf_Dispatcher $dispatcher)
    {
        $dispatcher->registerPlugin(new BenchmarkPlugin());
    }
}
?>
]]>
